text.oleaf.title: Oleaf
text.oleaf.overlay.editing: Overlay edit mode: use Mod Menu → Oleaf to move/resize the HUD.
text.oleaf.graphics_hub.title: Video Settings
text.oleaf.graphics_hub.subtitle: Choose a preset, then fine-tune. Apply saves Minecraft and Sodium settings.
text.oleaf.upscale.title: Upscale / FSR Settings
text.oleaf.upscale.subtitle: Real AMD FSR1 (EASU+RCAS) or SGSR1 — lower world res, native HUD
text.oleaf.upscale.disabled: Upscaler disabled — rendering at native resolution.
text.oleaf.overlay_settings.title: FPS Overlay Settings
text.oleaf.overlay_settings.subtitle: Enable the HUD, pick a corner, and choose which lines to show
text.oleaf.framegen.title: Frame Generation
text.oleaf.framegen.subtitle: Smoother motion with built-in frame interpolation
text.oleaf.framegen.tip: Higher multipliers (5x/6x) need Pace Frames on and VSync off. Adaptive FG may reduce generation during chunk loading. Max FPS is set in Video Settings.
text.oleaf.framegen.applied: Applied. VSync off. Max FPS unchanged — set it in Video Settings.
text.oleaf.graphics_hub.upscale_iris_rea: Iris installed: upscale works with shaders off. Apply rebuilds the pack when shaders are on.
text.oleaf.graphics_hub.upscale_iris_pac: Shader pack on: Apply enables upscale and rebuilds Iris at lower res (brief hitch).
Iris shader pack active — upscale hard-disabled (would look blurry).
text.oleaf.upscale.iris_pack_blocked: Upscale disabled: Iris shader pack is active
text.oleaf.advanced.title: Advanced Video Menus
text.oleaf.advanced.subtitle: Open the same menus your pack normally uses
text.oleaf.advanced.sodium_unavailable: Sodium settings could not be opened.
text.oleaf.advanced.sodium_fallback_vani: Sodium UI unavailable — opened Minecraft Video Settings.
text.oleaf.advanced.iris_unavailable: Iris shader menu could not be opened.
text.oleaf.advanced.restore_missing: No backup yet — apply a preset first.
text.oleaf.modmenu.main_help: Companion settings. For the full AAA-style graphics presets UI, use Options → Video Settings.
text.oleaf.modmenu.preset_tooltip: Remembers which graphics style you prefer. Use Graphics tab or Video Settings to apply it to Minecraft/Sodium.
text.oleaf.modmenu.advanced_mode_tooltip: Keeps extra helper text enabled in companion screens.
text.oleaf.modmenu.open_hub_help: Tip: Options → Video Settings opens the Graphics Hub (presets + easy sliders).
text.oleaf.modmenu.graphics_help: Apply the selected preset to Minecraft (and Sodium if installed). For full control, open Options → Video Settings.
text.oleaf.modmenu.apply_preset_now_tool: Turn ON, then Save to push the selected preset into Minecraft/Sodium options.
text.oleaf.modmenu.graphics_hint_distanc: • Render / Simulation / Entity Distance — how far the world and mobs draw
text.oleaf.modmenu.graphics_hint_fps: • Max FPS, VSync, Priority — smoothness vs responsiveness
text.oleaf.modmenu.graphics_hint_effects: • Particles, Clouds, Shadows, Bobbing — visual flair vs performance
text.oleaf.modmenu.upscale_help: Built-in upscaler: real AMD FSR1 (EASU then RCAS) or SGSR1. Lower world render res, then upscale. Helps GPU-bound FPS including Iris. HUD stays native. Not FSR2/4 or frame generation.
text.oleaf.modmenu.upscale_iris_warning: Iris is installed. Upscale works with or without an active pack. Applying settings rebuilds the Iris pipeline at the new resolution (short hitch).
text.oleaf.modmenu.upscale_quality_toolt: Ultra Quality ~77% … Performance ~50%, Ultra Performance ~40%, Off = native. Lower = more FPS when GPU-bound (shaders help most).
text.oleaf.modmenu.upscale_sharpen_toolt: For FSR1 this controls RCAS after EASU (on the upscaled image). Higher = sharper.
text.oleaf.modmenu.upscale_force_iris_to: Legacy option (unused). Upscale now works with Iris packs by default.
text.oleaf.modmenu.overlay_help: Compact HUD showing FPS, frame time, memory, ping, entities, FSR, and frame generation status.
text.oleaf.modmenu.show_fsr_tooltip: Show current upscale / FSR quality (or Off) on the performance overlay.
text.oleaf.modmenu.show_framegen_tooltip: Show frame generation Off or On with multiplier (2x–6x) on the performance overlay.
text.oleaf.modmenu.keybinds_help: Keybinds (Controls → Oleaf): Toggle Overlay, Edit Mode, Reset Position. Video Settings → FPS Overlay opens the same options.
text.oleaf.modmenu.detected_help: Installed optimization mods. Advanced View opens their native menus when available.
